items.claim: CEO 把 ChipStack Super Agent 定位為全新產品類別，非既有 GenAI 工具延伸
items.quote: This is a new product category, okay?
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: ChipStack 首次讓公司具備自動寫 RTL 與 test bench 的能力，過去從未做到
items.quote: we have never done is ability to write RTL or test bench
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: Hexagon 併購帶來最準確的機器人模擬器 Adams，用來補強 physical AI 的 sim-to-real 精度
items.quote: Hexagon had the most accurate robotic simulator with Adams
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說 physical AI 用的矽（車用、機器人）與 data center AI 用的矽不同，偏混合訊號與低功耗
items.quote: physical AI is different than the silicon for data center AI
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 去年整體營收成長約 14%、EPS 成長約 20%
items.quote: we grew like 14% and EPS grew around 20%, right?
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 公司近年 Rule of 40 落在高 50 幾，CEO 的目標是要突破 60
items.quote: we are in the high 50s, right, last few years
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 明確設定目標：Rule of 40 要跨越 60 這個門檻
items.quote: my goal is to crack 60.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 去年營業利益率 45%，但增量利潤率達 59%，即多增 1 億營收可多賺 5,900 萬利潤
items.quote: our margin last year was 45%, but incremental margin was 59%
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: Hexagon 併購今年對財務有影響，但主要落在融資面（稀釋/新增債務）而非營運面
items.quote: it is on financing side because there is some dilution
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 預期 Hexagon 併購明年就能轉為加值（accretive）
items.quote: And next year, it should be accretive.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: HBM IP 是透過向 Rambus 收購取得，CEO 稱是一筆好收購
items.quote: we did acquire from Rambus. That's a great acquisition.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 除既有大型半導體客戶外，Tesla、Rivian、BYD 等 OEM 廠自研晶片也成為客戶
items.quote: now with OEM players like Tesla and Rivian or BYD
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 中國今年設計活動熱絡、physical AI 需求大，環境比去年初更穩定
items.quote: the environment seems more stable than beginning of '25
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 面對中國本土 EDA 業者競爭，CEO 稱一直都有競爭
items.quote: there's always some competition, I think.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: Palladium 硬體事業已連續 6 年寫下創紀錄成長
items.quote: we have like 6 years in a row of record growth in Palladium
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 對今年 Palladium 展望偏樂觀，但公司年初給假設時一貫採取保守態度
items.quote: we are more prudent in the assumption
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 針對 AI 是否顛覆傳統軟體商業模式的疑慮，CEO 回應這是放大而非顛覆
items.quote: for us, it's not disruption, it is amplification
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: Agentic EDA（ChipStack）貨幣化模式將採 token-based 計費
items.quote: yes, I think it will be token-based
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: 公司希望新 agent 產品採基礎訂閱費加 token 用量的計費結構
items.quote: we would hope to have a base subscription plus tokens
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示 IP 業務已是連續第三年強勁成長，且公司不會提前宣稱未驗證的趨勢
items.quote: it's the third year of very good growth we will have
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)
